# Posewise

> Posewise is an iPhone app that uses the phone's camera to check yoga pose alignment. It measures joint angles from the side or front, speaks corrections out loud while you hold the pose, and builds a short daily workout (about six minutes) of the strength, flexibility and mobility exercises that address the specific faults it found. Pose detection runs on the device; no video is uploaded. It covers 14 poses and is currently in beta.

## Pose guides

- [How to improve your Downward Dog](https://posewise.app/poses/downward-dog): the five things that usually hold back Downward Dog (tight hamstrings, tight calves, stiff shoulders, weak pressing strength, stiff wrists), what each does to the pose, and a daily exercise for each.
- [How to improve your Warrior II](https://posewise.app/poses/warrior-2): the five things that usually hold back Warrior II (leg strength for a 90° front knee, outer-hip strength for knee tracking, tight groin and quads bending the back leg, core strength for an upright torso, shoulder endurance for level arms), with a daily exercise for each.

## About

- [Home](https://posewise.app/): what Posewise does, the poses it covers, and how to join the beta.
